basic_info.description: Beautiful Light Filled Corner Unit Condo! This modern 1 bedroom condo is located in the desirable Lake St District. Stunning corner unit has lots of natural light throughout. There are hardwood floors throughout the condo.  Spacious open floor plan boasts bright living room with a gas fireplace and double-pane bay windows. Separate dining area is great for entertaining. Modern kitchen has granite countertops, newer stainless steel gas stove, dishwasher & refrigerator. The beautiful bathroom has been recently completely remodeled with a walk-in shower.  A generous huge private deck can be accessed from the living room and bedroom. Convenient free laundry on site. Built in 1993, this is a well-maintained 12 unit building. 1 car deeded parking.  Steps from the Presidio, public transportation, restaurants & all conveniences.  Monthly HOA Fee of $457 includes water, garbage, earthquake insurance (!), common area gas & electricity, professional property management, building insurance and building maintenance.
